rating.label: ICRA rating
rating.summary: ICRA expects BEL to register an annual revenue growth of 10%-15% over the near to medium term, while maintaining its robust coverage metrics and superior liquidity position in the interim. ICRA takes note of the increase in its working capital intensity in FY2025, primarily on account of lower customer advances owing to lower order inflows (due to impact of the union elections in Q1 FY2025).
